rationale: Direct evidence establishes ConRAC as an iCON project-equity program label rather than one disclosed company and verifies AVP QTA LLC as the only specifically evidenced iCON-backed project, while Conrac Solutions is a separate Meridiam-owned developer and operator. No direct source identifies AVP QTA LLC's legal members, iCON fund or vehicle, stake, co-owners, retained interests, current status, full project roster, partnership renewal or termination, or treatment of iCON project interests in the Meridiam transaction. An omnibus company or ownership record cannot be created without inference.

evidence.purpose: Direct airport evidence for the verified iCON-backed AVP project, role separation, operating-company boundaries, and the precise limits of the public ownership record.
